description: This is a FastAPI-based backend API implementation for a Personal Study Tracker application. It includes user authentication, study session management (create, list, update, delete), health check, and leaderboard features, with database models for users and study sessions.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for SQLAlchemy models using DeclarativeBase.

classes.name: User
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing application users with email and password hash.

classes.name: StudySession
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing individual study sessions linked to users.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for JWT token response.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for user data exposed externally.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for user registration input.

classes.name: StudySessionCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating or updating study sessions.

classes.name: StudySessionOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for study session data exposed externally.

classes.name: SessionsListResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for paginated list of study sessions.

classes.name: LeaderboardEntry
classes.description: Pydantic model for leaderboard user entries.

classes.name: LeaderboardResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for leaderboard data containing all-time and last 30 days.

methods.name: get_db
methods.description: Dependency that provides a database session per request.

methods.name: hash_password
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a stored hash.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for a user.

methods.name: decode_token
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on the JWT token.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Performs a health check, including database connectivity.

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password.

methods.name: login_user
methods.description: Authenticates user and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new study session for the current user.

methods.name: list_sessions
methods.description: Lists study sessions with pagination and filters.

methods.name: delete_session
methods.description: Deletes a specific study session by ID.

methods.name: leaderboard
methods.description: Returns the leaderboard with top users by total minutes.

methods.name: on_startup
methods.description: Ensures database tables exist on startup and logs CORS configuration.
